On June 15, 2026, Disney Branded Television rebranded itself as Disney Kids & Family. This change reflects a strategic shift to better represent the division's focus on family and children's content. Under this new branding, the Disney Channel will continue to target kids ages 6 through teens, Disney Jr. will cater to preschool audiences, and Disney+ will remain as the division’s family co-viewing platform.

FINAL: Disney Kids & Family.
